strategy: Accelerate into [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]], then turn combat damage into extra mana and use her triggers to break parity on [[Winter Orb]]. Cheap draw engines and tutors help you assemble [[Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy]] plus [[Basalt Monolith]] for unlimited colorless mana, which [[Finale of Devastation]] can turn into a lethal attack if you have the green mana and creatures to connect. This is optimized Bracket 4 stax-combo: spend the opening turns building mana, drawing cards, and disrupting opponents, with turn four or later as the expected closing window.

research.summary:
## [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] — Commander deckbuilding guide

**1. Main builds**
- **Birds / flying tempo:** Lead with cheap evasive creatures, turn combat damage into extra mana or untaps, and win through the air.
- **Tap/untap value or stax:** Reuse mana sources and tap abilities, or break the symmetry of untap restrictions. Creature-based disruption also gives you bodies to attack with.
- **Blink / combo:** Repeatedly blink your commander to untap a mana source. More competitive lists often add a creature toolbox built around [[Birthing Pod]]. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/derevi-empyrial-tactician?utm_source=openai))

**2. Key synergy cards**
- **Combat:** [[Kastral, the Windcrested]] rewards Bird hits; [[Reconnaissance Mission]] turns connecting creatures into cards.
- **Mana:** [[Bloom Tender]], [[Faeburrow Elder]], and lands enchanted with [[Utopia Sprawl]] or [[Wild Growth]] make each untap worth more.
- **Stax:** [[Winter Orb]] and [[Static Orb]] stop restricting untaps while tapped. Use the commander’s entry trigger to tap your own Orb before your turn, then untap normally. [[Stasis]] is a different plan: your triggers can help pay its upkeep, but tapping it doesn’t turn it off. ([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/derevi-empyrial-tactician?utm_source=openai))

**3. Established combo lines**

| Cards | What they produce |
|---|---|
| [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] + [[Emiel the Blessed]] + [[Bloom Tender]] | With the mana creature ready to tap for three, blink the commander repeatedly for unlimited entry and exit triggers. **No net mana** at three per tap. |
| [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] + [[Deadeye Navigator]] + [[Bloom Tender]] | Pair the navigator with the commander. Each blink costs two and untaps the mana creature, which taps for three: unlimited green and white mana and entry/exit triggers. |
| [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] + [[Ashnod's Altar]] + [[Bloom Tender]] | Tap the mana creature **before** sacrificing the commander. Return the commander from the command zone and untap the mana creature. Nets one colorless mana per loop, plus unlimited death and entry triggers. |

([edhrec.com](https://edhrec.com/commanders/derevi-empyrial-tactician/core/combos))

**4. Common pitfalls.** Don’t fill a combat build with expensive Birds that can’t help you connect early; [[Airborne Aid]] is a cut candidate if you rarely have several Birds on board. Don’t pack untap locks without a way to keep attacking or close the game. And don’t count combat-generated mana toward ordinary postcombat spells: spend it during combat, leave the source untapped for later, or run instant-speed outlets. The command-zone ability isn’t a cast and doesn’t incur commander tax. ([cloudflare.edhrec.com](https://cloudflare.edhrec.com/articles/technically-playable-derevi-empyrial-tactician?utm_source=openai))

**5. Mana base.** Start around **35–37 lands** for a non-cEDH build. Prioritize untapped green on turn one and access to all three colors by turn three. [[Breeding Pool]] and [[Temple Garden]] fix colors and can carry [[Utopia Sprawl]]; keep basic green sources too. Limit tapped lands and colorless utility slots: the command-zone ability still needs green, white, and blue. [[Gaea's Cradle]] is a strong optional untap target in creature-heavy lists, not a substitute for reliable opening green. ([cloudflare.edhrec.com](https://cloudflare.edhrec.com/commanders/derevi-empyrial-tactician/core/birds/decks?utm_source=openai))

synergies.title: One-Sided Winter
synergies.explanation: Use [[Opposition]] to tap [[Winter Orb]] during the end step before your turn so all your lands can untap. Then use a combat-damage trigger from [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] to untap [[Winter Orb]] before your opponents' turns.

synergies.title: Tap, Token, Repeat
synergies.explanation: Tap [[Stonybrook Schoolmaster]] with [[Opposition]] to deny an opposing permanent and create a token that can immediately pay for another activation. [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] untaps the Schoolmaster when your creatures connect, and [[Murkfiend Liege]] refreshes it and its blue tokens during each opponent's untap step.

synergies.title: Break the Mana Lock
synergies.explanation: [[Hokori, Dust Drinker]] keeps lands from untapping normally, but [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] turns combat hits into extra untaps of [[Selesnya Sanctuary]] for two mana or [[Mana Vault]] for three. The artifact also keeps your mana production from depending entirely on lands.

synergies.title: Untap and Tax
synergies.explanation: [[Stoic Angel]] and [[Rising Waters]] restrict normal creature and land untaps, but [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] lets successful attacks untap your creatures or mana sources outside the untap step. [[Windborn Muse]] makes it harder for opponents to attack you with their limited mana.

synergies.title: Nest-Fueled Demolition
synergies.explanation: Use triggers from [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] to untap the land enchanted by [[Squirrel Nest]], turning each untap into another Squirrel. Each token entering gives [[Aura Shards]] another chance to destroy an artifact or enchantment.

synergies.title: Three Colors, Four Mana
synergies.explanation: [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] supplies all three colors for [[Bloom Tender]] and [[Faeburrow Elder]], and [[Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy]] raises either creature's output to four mana per tap. Combat hits let you untap and reuse those mana creatures to fund spells or more activations of [[Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy]].

synergies.title: Blink, Recover, Rebuild
synergies.explanation: Blinking [[Reveillark]] with [[Emiel the Blessed]] can bring back [[Eternal Witness]] to recover any card from your graveyard. Blinking [[Sun Titan]] gives you another way to return [[Eternal Witness]] or recover a different cheap permanent directly to the battlefield.

synergies.title: Hit for Cards and Mana
synergies.explanation: When [[Lu Xun, Scholar General]] connects through horsemanship, it can draw a card on its own and another through [[Bident of Thassa]], while [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] can untap a mana source to help cast what you drew.

original.summary: [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] turns combat hits into extra mana and helps break parity under [[Winter Orb]]. Keep opponents short on mana, then finish with a wide attack or repeated combat steps under the lock.
early: Use [[Cultivate]] or [[Kodama's Reach]] to get your missing colors.
Land [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] early and use its entrance trigger to untap a land.
Untap [[Azorius Chancery]] after a combat hit to reuse both mana.
mid: Attack with [[Lu Xun, Scholar General]] alongside [[Bident of Thassa]] to draw two cards.
Use [[Opposition]] to tap opposing lands during upkeep and blockers before combat.
Tap [[Winter Orb]] with [[Opposition]] before your untap step so your lands untap normally.
late: Untap the land enchanted by [[Squirrel Nest]] to make more tokens for [[Aura Shards]].
Stack zero-value activations of [[Mirror Entity]] and recycle [[Reveillark]] with [[Karmic Guide]].
Return [[Acidic Slime]] alongside [[Karmic Guide]] to destroy another land each loop.
winConditions: Pump your tokens with [[Mirror Entity]] and swing after [[Opposition]] taps their blockers.
Land [[True Conviction]] to double combat damage and get twice the triggers from [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]].
Loop [[Acidic Slime]] with [[Reveillark]] to dismantle opposing mana, then win through combat.

keyCards.name: Derevi, Empyrial Tactician
keyCards.why: Turns combat hits into mana or taps down blockers.

keyCards.name: Opposition
keyCards.why: Turns spare creatures into repeatable mana denial.

keyCards.name: Winter Orb
keyCards.why: Restricts land untaps only while it stays untapped.

keyCards.name: Stonybrook Schoolmaster
keyCards.why: Makes a token whenever it becomes tapped.

keyCards.name: Murkfiend Liege
keyCards.why: Readies blue and green creatures on opponents' turns.

original.mulligan: Keep three lands with access to all three colors, plus [[Cultivate]] or an early play like [[Rhystic Study]].
watchOut: Avoid playing [[Winter Orb]] before you can tap it or untap extra lands.
Graveyard exile can break the loop by removing [[Karmic Guide]] before [[Reveillark]] returns it.
[[Sunblast Angel]] destroys your tapped attackers too, so check your board before casting it.

optimized.summary: [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] turns combat damage into extra mana while [[Opposition]] keeps opponents short on resources. Finish with a huge [[Finale of Devastation]] or use infinite colorless mana to deck an opponent with [[Stroke of Genius]].
early: Lead with [[Birds of Paradise]] to fix your colors for [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]].
Play [[Bloom Tender]] early so [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]] lets it tap for three colors.
mid: Attack with [[Lu Xun, Scholar General]] to draw cards and trigger [[Derevi, Empyrial Tactician]].
Use [[Opposition]] to tap [[Winter Orb]] before your untap step so your lands untap normally.
Tap [[Stonybrook Schoolmaster]] to pay for [[Opposition]], then use the new token to tap something.
late: Use [[Enlightened Tutor]] to find [[Basalt Monolith]] when [[Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy]] is ready.
Blink [[Eternal Witness]] with [[Emiel the Blessed]] to recover a countered [[Finale of Devastation]].
winConditions: Pair [[Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy]] with [[Basalt Monolith]] to fuel a lethal [[Stroke of Genius]].
Equip [[Sword of the Paruns]] to [[Bloom Tender]] producing four mana, then loop untaps.
Spend that mana on [[Finale of Devastation]] to give your creatures lethal power and haste.
